scope: Offline owner-recording STT replay; frozen English cohort and supported, model-assisted verbatim references. Not live end-to-end latency or human/audio-adjudicated accuracy.
integrity: All three new replay receipts report verified full-precision 614-case completion; STT and metadata file hashes match their receipts. Baseline is the frozen production turbo replay.
measurement_notes: WER uses NFKC/case and punctuation normalization followed by word-level edit distance; numbers are not normalized. References are model-assisted, not human-verified, and WER is not a semantic quality judgment.

605 English cases are classified once from the frozen baseline STT, not independently by each system. The 300 supported references are a subset; failures and empty text are retained and represented as empty hypotheses in alignment.

Timing uses the same 613 cases with successful, nonzero timing across all arms. STT time measures the transcription call and chunk processing after audio loading; it excludes model load and live capture, cleanup and insertion. Separate runs were not a randomized thermal or concurrency-controlled benchmark.

RSS is the maximum process-lifetime peak reported by ru_maxrss on macOS, in bytes. It includes process and model lifetime; it is not per-case memory, incremental model allocation, or a separate GPU peak.
Parakeet replay does not use the Whisper recognition glossary. These are offline full-precision Parakeet replays, not a comparison under identical recognition prompting.
No model default or production routing decision follows from these results.
